items.title: 屯門醫院懷疑有人擅自取走手術室內止痛藥物 一名外科醫生被捕
items.summary: 屯門醫院表示，早前接獲部門報告，懷疑有人擅自取走手術室內，屬於危險藥物類別、用作止痛的藥物，院方報警，警方拘捕一名外科醫生，涉案醫生已離職。 院方的聲明說，事發期間有一名病人於相關手術室接受手術，經詳細臨床評估後，確認事件對病人的手術過程、治療及術後康復沒有影響，院方已向病人致歉，並繼續提供適切協助。…
items.titleEn: A surgeon was arrested on suspicion of illegally taking painkillers from the operating room.
items.summaryEn: The hospital in Shenzhen said it had received reports from the department earlier that it was suspected that someone had taken dangerous drugs into the operating room illegally, used as painkillers, and that the police had arrested a surgeon, and the doctor had resigned. The hospital said that one patient had undergone surgery at the relevant operating room during the incident, and that after a detailed clinical evaluation, it was confirmed that the incident did not affect the patient's surgical process, treatment and post-operative recovery, the hospital apologized to the patient and continued to provide appropriate assistance. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 香港藝術節網站遭入侵 初步懷疑數千名觀眾資料外洩
items.summary: 香港藝術節協會表示，星期一發現協會的主網站，遭到未經授權的第三方入侵，已經向警方報案及通報個人資料私隱專員公署，協會就事件深表歉意。 香港藝術節的聲明說，與外判網站服務及雲端託管承辦商深入調查，並即時採取措施防止未經授權的第三方再次非法入侵，初步懷疑數千名第55屆藝術節門票預訂觀眾的個人資料，可能曾經被未經授權人士非法閱覽，協會已經透過電郵通知可能受影響的觀眾，強調會全力配合調查，並採取適當措施，防止同類事件再次發生。…
items.titleEn: Hong Kong Art Festival website was hacked and thousands of viewers were initially suspected of leaking data
items.summaryEn: The Hong Kong Arts Festival Association said that the main website of the association, which was found to have been hacked by unauthorized third parties on Monday, had been reported to the police and reported to the Office of the Specialist in Privacy of Personal Information, and the association apologized deeply for the incident. The Hong Kong Arts Festival said in a statement that it has conducted a thorough investigation with outsourced website services and cloud trustees and has taken immediate steps to prevent unauthorized third-party re-introduction, initially doubting the personal data of thousands of viewers who booked tickets to the 55th Festival, which may have been illegally accessed by unauthorized persons, and that the association has notified potential affected audiences via email, stressing its full cooperation with the investigation, and taking appropriate measures to prevent similar incidents from happening again. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: The Catholic Church celebrates the deaths of the Holocaust in memory of Caesar
items.summaryEn: The Catholic Church of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception celebrates the deaths of the victims of the devastating fire. In a speech, the priest Chen Zhiming, who presided over Caesar, said that thinking about the space that Caesar can bring to the world to support each other, to bring the bereaved together, is a process of healing. He also said that specific actions should be taken to care for the families affected, promote housing security, and accompany the families who have passed away. The residents of Hong Kong and the families of the fires then arrived at the altar to receive the blessings of the priest. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 香港中醫醫院與湖南中醫藥大學第一附屬醫院簽署戰略合作協議
items.summary: 香港中醫醫院與湖南中醫藥大學第一附屬醫院簽署戰略合作協議，出席見證的醫務衞生局副局長范婉雯表示，國家「十五五」規劃強調要推進中醫藥傳承創新、健全中醫藥服務體系及發展中西醫協同服務。特區政府透過建設香港中醫醫院，促進中西醫協作服務、臨床人才培養及中醫藥科研的發展。她形容，今次兩院建立戰略合作夥伴關係，將攜手打造國際中醫藥人才及資源集聚高地，向世界弘揚中醫藥文化。…
items.titleEn: Hong Kong Central Medical Hospital and the First Affiliated Hospital of the Chinese Medical University of Hunan signed a Strategic Partnership Agreement
items.summaryEn: The Hong Kong Central Medical Hospital and the First Affiliate Hospital of the Chinese Medical University of Hunan signed a strategic cooperation agreement, and Vice Director of the Bureau of Medical Biology, Dr. Van Phuong, who attended the testimony, said that the national "15th Five" plan emphasizes promoting innovation in traditional Chinese medicine, strengthening the Chinese medical service system and developing Western medical cooperation services. The special government is building a medical hospital in Hong Kong, promoting the development of medical collaboration services in Western China, developing clinical talent and research in medicine in Hong Kong. She described the two institutes as establishing strategic partnerships that will help build international Chinese medicine talent and resources to bring the culture of Chinese medicine to the world. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 回應有網民稱特區護照缺漏部份內頁 入境處疑有人無合法授權改動

items.title: 疑未獲授權為兒童病房男病人檢查 威院男醫生涉非禮被捕

items.titleEn: Suspected of unlicensed examination of male patients in children's hospitals, male doctors at the Wesleyan hospital were arrested for disorderly conduct
items.summaryEn: The Prince of Wales Hospital said that a doctor had previously suspected that two male patients had been examined in a pediatric surgery clinic without the authorization of the governing body, and the hospital reported the incident to the police. Police said a 31-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of disorderly conduct and was granted bail pending investigation, and the case is being investigated by the Shaddai Police Task Force. The academy said the incident was of great importance, and that the arrest of the doctor responsible for teaching and clinical work at the academy had promptly banned him from entering the clinical scope of the institute and terminated his access to clinical work and access to the clinical healthcare system. In the meantime, the government has suspended all the functions of the teacher and will investigate him according to the relevant procedures. I'm not going to lie.

items.summaryEn: In the afternoon, the Director of the Office of Innovation, Technology and Industry, Sun Tzu, moved to the city of Hubei, Anhui province to continue his visit. In a speech at an exchange event, he said that Hong Kong is accelerating the promotion of innovation in the three largest innovation parks and the five largest development agencies; Hong Kong will not only provide a research and development platform for local companies that want to develop in Hong Kong, but will also help companies connect top scientific talents and international innovation resources to fully enhance their research capacity. items.titleEn: Lee Geun-hye: Transforming the first five-year plan from a vision map to a landscape map is essential for business
items.summaryEn: Hong Kong's chief executive, Lee Hsien Loong, said that Hong Kong must work hard to transform its first five-year plan from a vision to a landscape in the "15th Five-Year Period", in which the power of the business sector is essential. In a speech at the 55th China General Chamber of Commerce in Hong Kong, Li said he hopes that the Chinese general and business community will continue to work with the government to encourage domestic companies to take advantage of Hong Kong's advantages and to attract more foreign companies to invest in Hong Kong and the domestic market, bringing more opportunities to Hong Kong' s business community and contributing to the nation's strength-building. items.title: 香港電訊明年2月25日終止提供3G服務
items.summary: 香港電訊宣布，明年2月25日終止提供3G服務，以優化頻譜分配，滿足市場對更先進流動服務的需求。現時用於3G網絡的頻譜資源，將會重新調配至5G網絡，以加強網絡穩定性與流暢度。 公司表示，隨著人工智能（AI）應用日益普及，以及各類數碼服務和科技急速發展，本地消費者對5G流動通訊網絡和服務的需求亦與日俱增。…
items.titleEn: Hong Kong Telecom will end its 3G service on February 25 next year
items.summaryEn: Hong Kong Telecom has announced that it will end its 3G service on February 25 next year to optimize the frequency distribution to meet the market's demand for more advanced streaming services. The frequency resources currently used in 3G networks will be re-modulated to 5G networks to enhance network stability and fluidity. According to the company, with the increasing popularity of AI applications, as well as the rapid development of digital services and technology, the demand for 5G mobile communications networks and services by local consumers is also increasing. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: Zhang Chang-hwan attended a joint meeting of the legal department of the Bay Area to create a platform for promoting arbitration to resolve Bay Area standards
items.summaryEn: The Deputy Director of the Department of Law, Zhang Cheng-hwang, led a delegation to Macau to attend the eighth joint meeting of the legal department of the Hong Kong Bay Area, and engaged in deep discussions with the Director of the Ministry of Justice of Guangdong Province, Chen-hwang-dong, and the Director of Administrative Legal Affairs of the Macau Provincial Government, Huang Zhao. The first of more than a dozen institutions to join the platform will work closely with the Joint Assembly to promote relevant Bay Area Standards and collect industry and consumer opinions, promote the integration of the three-state arbitration mechanism, continue to improve relevant standards, reduce cross-border dispute resolution costs, and better serve high-quality development in the Bay Area.
